final_draft.note: I couldn't find an approved answer or policy text about cyber liability insurance or its coverage limit. I searched for 'cyber liability insurance coverage limit' and found nothing. A broader search for 'insurance policy' found only unrelated Access Control Policy sections: leavers, authentication and accounts. The live-setting checks only look at GitHub and AWS settings, so they can't answer an insurance question. Whoever owns insurance, probably finance or legal, needs to provide and approve the answer, including whether the company has cyber cover, the carrier if it's to be shared, and the coverage limit.
